mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inducer that increases mexiletine metabolism, potentially reducing its antiarrhythmic efficacy; both drugs also have additive CNS depressant effects and may lower seizure threshold.
action: Monitor mexiletine efficacy and serum levels; adjust mexiletine dose based on therapeutic drug monitoring; assess for increased seizure risk and CNS effects.
